name: First Steps
description: Learn to walk, jump and throw. Pip will show you around: walk up to Pip and press {use} to talk.

npcs.name: Pip
lines: Hi, I'm Pip! Walk with {left} and {right}, and jump with {jump}.
Tap {jump} for a little hop, or hold it down to jump as high as you can.
Climb the steps to the door at the top right. Press {use} at a door to open it, then {use} again to go through.
Up there is a red frog. Touching it hurts! Click with the mouse to throw a glowing orb at it.
Hearts and glowing orbs are power-ups. Your time is at the top, and next time a ghost of your best run races you.
Press Esc any time to pause, restart or change your keys. Have fun!
